links.outcome: Readability grade level of AI and physician tracheostomy patient education responses versus NIH 6th-grade recommendation
links.effect: All AI and expert responses exceeded the NIH-recommended 6th-grade reading level, ranging from 10th-13th grade (P < .001).
links.quote: All AI and expert responses exceeded the NIH-recommended 6th-grade reading level, ranging from 10th-13th grade (P < .001).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of 5 commercial LLMs answering tracheostomy patient FAQs compared with expert responses; assesses accuracy, completeness, and readability without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
